In 1859, America and Britain almost went to war over a pig!
And the only one who died, was the pig!
It happened on San Juan Island, a patch of land that both countries claimed.
One morning, an American farmer named Lyman Cutlar, found a huge black pig, eating his potatoes.
He grabbed his gun, and shot it dead!
But the pig belonged to a British company, and the British wanted him arrested!
So the Americans sent soldiers. The British sent warships. Soon, hundreds of men with cannons, faced five giant warships, over one dead pig!
But the British admiral refused to start a war. He said, it would be foolish, to fight over a pig.
For twelve years, both armies shared the island, and even threw dinner parties together.
In 1872, a German emperor settled it, and gave the whole island to America.
So the Pig War had zero battles, and exactly one casualty!
